models.name: Flint 40B A2.5B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE (no AA v5 index as of 2026-11-06): vendor-reported Terminal-Bench 2.1 54.9% and SWE-bench Verified 74.2% (RecursiveSI/flint model card, fetched 2026-11-06); TB2.1 is level with K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B (56.6% on AA), which fits to 13.0, so estimate 12.0. Not independently verified.
models.notes: Released 2026-10-21. 39.8B total, about 2.5B active (2.2B body), 49 layers (2 dense + 47 MoE), 256 routed experts top-6 plus a shared expert. 35 sliding-window layers (window 513) and 14 full-attention layers, so KV is only 1.9GB at 64K f16. 262K context. Built for coding agents: vendor-reported Terminal-Bench 2.1 54.9%, SWE-bench Pro v2 89.7%, SWE-bench Verified 74.2% (model card, 2026-11-06); no Artificial Analysis row yet. Multi-turn tool use and reasoning are in the chat template. Apache-2.0.

models.name: K2 Horizon MoVA 36B A4B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE: v5-equivalent from AA's published v5 components (AA-Briefcase 1164.8, GDPval-AA 1196.7, AutomationBench 26.1%, GDP.pdf 4.2%, HLE-Diamond 23.4%, AA-LCR 71.7%, TB2.1 56.6%, SciCode 40.0%, GPQA 82.2%, tau3-Banking 32.0%) via linear fit on 38 models with an official v5 index (RMSE 2.9) -> 14.1; legacy fit (HLE, AA-LCR, GDPval, CritPt) on 87 models -> 12.7; use 13.0. Fetched 2026-11-06.
models.notes: Released 2026-09-01. Mixture-of-Experts with Mixture-of-Values attention: 100 experts, top-8 plus one shared, 4B active out of 37.4B counted (36B nominal). Native 524K context, fully open (training data, recipe and code published). AA components fetched 2026-11-06: AA-Briefcase 1164.8, GDPval-AA 1196.7, AutomationBench 26.1%, HLE-Diamond 23.4%, AA-LCR 71.7%, TB2.1 56.6%, SciCode 40.0%, GPQA 82.2%, tau3-Banking 32.0%. Vendor card: tau3-Banking 26.8, TB2.1 58.6, HLE 25.2, GPQA 80.8. All 48 layers are full attention, so KV is 12.9GB at 64K f16 and Q6_K is the sweet spot at 48GB. Reasoning effort and tool calling are in the chat template (43KB).

models.name: HyperNova 60B 2605
models.score_source: ESTIMATE: legacy fit (HLE 16.6%, AA-LCR 36.3%, GDPval-AA 448.6, CritPt 0.9%) on 87 models with an official v5 index (RMSE 4.9) -> 8.5; v5-component fit -> 5.6; use 7.0. Low AA-Briefcase 232 and GDP.pdf 0.1% pull it down. AA components fetched 2026-11-06.
models.notes: Released 2026-04-30. CompactifAI compression of gpt-oss-120b to 58.7B total and 4.8B active (80 experts, top-4). Native OpenAI-style tool calling, configurable reasoning effort, 131K context. Half the layers are sliding-window (128), so KV is only 2.2GB at 64K f16. AA components fetched 2026-11-06: HLE 16.6%, AA-LCR 36.3%, GDPval-AA 448.6, IFBench 66.5%, tau2 63.2%, GPQA 73.3%, AA-Briefcase 232, GDP.pdf 0.1%. Apache-2.0.

models.name: EXAONE 4.5 33B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE: legacy fit (HLE 12.9%, AA-LCR 54.7%, GDPval-AA 474.5, CritPt 0.3%) on 87 models with an official v5 index (RMSE 4.9) -> 4.2. AA has no v5 components for it yet (tau2 78.1%, GPQA 79.4%, TB-hard 20.5% are v4-era). Fetched 2026-11-06.
models.notes: Released 2026-04-04. 33B dense model plus a 1.2B vision encoder (34.35B counted), 262K context, 3:1 sliding-window (4096) to full attention over 65 blocks, one of which is an MTP layer. Multilingual (en, ko, es, de, ja, vi) with strong document understanding. AA components fetched 2026-11-06: tau2 78.1%, GPQA 79.4%, HLE 12.9%, AA-LCR 54.7%, IFBench 58.0%, TB-hard 20.5%. License is EXAONE 1.2-NC: research and non-commercial use only, which blocks a paid deployment. Tool calling is in the chat template; vision needs the separate mmproj file.

models.name: Kimi Linear 48B A3B Instruct
models.score_source: ESTIMATE (no v5 index): AA v4-era components GPQA 41.2%, HLE 2.5%, AA-LCR 28.0%, LiveCodeBench 37.8%, AIME-2025 36.3% imply a low v5 index (about 2); the legacy fit needs GDPval and CritPt, which AA did not publish for this model. Fetched 2026-11-06. Treat as a long-context specialist, not a general pick.
models.notes: Released 2025-10-30. Kimi Delta Attention (linear attention) with 7 full-attention layers out of 27; 48B total, 3B active, 256 experts top-8. 1M context and a very small cache: 1.0GB at 64K, 4.1GB at 256K, 16.5GB at 1M f16 (MLA, one KV head). MIT. AA components fetched 2026-11-06: GPQA 41.2%, HLE 2.5%, AA-LCR 28.0%, LiveCodeBench 37.8%, AIME-2025 36.3%. Dated against 2026 models; kept only because it is the cheapest way to get a real 1M-token window at this memory tier. Tool calling is in the chat template.
